## Specific task description

Task instruction: Click the top button of the blue alarm clock

Task description: The target is the button on top of the blue alarm clock currently on the right side of the table. Click the button once.

Success criteria: The right gripper must be closed and make actual contact with the clock near its top button, close to both the button position and surface height. Merely remaining above the button does not count.

## Execution tips

- Close the right gripper above the alarm clock where there is sufficient clearance, then approach the button with the fingertips. This reduces the risk of the spread fingers first hitting the sides of the case.
- Contact the visible top surface of the button at a point with clearance from its edge, and press down slowly in a small movement to click it. This reduces sideways pushing that could make the fingertip slide onto the housing.
